answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the spiral is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The jetty holds work receipts rather than names, so the island of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
